enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Nearly Finished: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to a Cannith Reforging Station and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.

children.tooltip: Completed Weapon: This item is fully completed, and as a result deals an additional .5W damage.

Utter Disintegration: This weapon has a dark, insidious power deep within. Occasionally, this power lashes out violently at enemies and attempts to disintegrate them. This disintegrate is incredibly powerful, and will utterly destroy weaker foes.

enchantments.tooltip: Impact: Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification.

Overwhelming Shockwave: This legendary weapon resonates with incredible power. On a Vorpal strike that is confirmed as a critical hit, it releases a Shockwave that does tremendous Sonic damage to all foes. Furthermore, the enemy that the shockwave is released on is Dazed from the force of the blast.
Screeching 14: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to pulse with sound, dealing 14d6 Sonic damage on each critical hit.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
